reason: A chat utility plugin that adds UI controls and HTTP RPCs for reading, editing, rewriting, and regenerating conversation messages; human review is warranted because edits can truncate later nodes and the README documents a compatibility issue that can make compaction fail.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供消息读取、编辑、改写和重新生成能力，并在助手消息操作条中加入相应的编辑界面。
summaries.en: Adds DeepSeek Harness Web controls and HTTP RPCs for reading, editing, rewriting, and regenerating conversation messages.

capabilities: Reads assistant message text through an HTTP API
Rewrites assistant message content including reasoning and body
Edits user messages and truncates subsequent conversation nodes
Injects chat message action controls and an inline editor into the web UI
